summary.text: Yasmine Outlaw is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Ryan Clancy (D).
A policy analyst and Milwaukee native, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her campaign focuses on family affordability, education and lower taxes.

paragraphs.text: Outlaw graduated from Riverside University High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee in 2018 and a graduate degree from DePaul University in 2021, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her career experience as working as a policy analyst.
In her Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a Milwaukee native from a military family who holds a Master of Public Administration.

Her campaign messages included making it possible for Wisconsin families to afford a home and for children to receive an education that prepares them for work, and reducing taxes to attract companies that hire local talent.
She listed taxes, education, housing and safety as her areas of policy interest.
